card.name: Topical and spray product application directions
card.fires_on: Spots inside directions for sprays, creams, gels and lotions, often a space or number piece just before a count or amount. It also fires inside topical brand names and words like ochronosis.

modes.label: Spray count directions
modes.description: The gap or number after a dash in a range of sprays under the tongue.

modes.label: Topical product wording
modes.description: Pieces of cream, gel or lotion names and application steps, such as tube use or pump actuation.
modes.example: Each tube of FIL<<SU>>VEZ is for one-time use only

modes.label: Numbers in topical directions
modes.description: Digits or spaces before durations and strengths for creams and lotions.
modes.example: to the affected area 3 times daily for <<1>>0 days.

card.writes: It promotes words for containers and topical forms such as bottle, spray, gel and cream, including Chinese equivalents.
card.plain: It lights up in instructions for sprays, creams and gels, where the next word is likely a bottle, tube or topical form.
